id./param/scenario/cs/a_150_cs_110.pack|cs_: "This veil was my grandpa's. Ma said when she found him after he died, he was holding onto it...
"I never threw it away. If you really know where to find that mermaid, take it to her and tell her he's dead.
"Sorry if I was short with you back there. It hasn't been easy for me and my ma.
"After Grandpa died, they let her go back to the village and marry a local guy. But it didn't stop folks talking...
"But she rose above it, turned it into that story show of hers, and now that's how she makes her living. She's tough.
"I hate that mermaid for what she's put us through. I don't want my kids to suffer like we have.
"The Kahuna's finally letting me sail with the other men. The curse is nearly undone. Please, take the veil and end it.
